newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rising,investors aim blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rising,investors aim blue chips.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may move up marginally when the market reopens after a public holiday, brokers said.
"The market is stabilising through a limited correction. But there is demand for blue chips," said broker Moshtaque Ahmed.

Broker Khurshid Alam said: "Investors are coming up with new funds and the market may have steady rise." Brokers said the blue chips like Singer Bangladesh, Aziz Pipes, Beximco Pharma and Eastern Housing might be attractive to the small investors. The DSE all-share price index closed 7.29 points or 0.34 percent down at 2,128.13 on a turnover of 323.4 million taka on Monday.
